name: Lord Arkkoroc
summary: Lord Arkkoroc is an ancient, towering sea giant who dwells within the ruined Temple of Arkkoran along the ragged coast of Azshara. Described by the demon hunter Loramus Thalipedes as a lesser deity, he holds sway over the surrounding waters and commands lesser sea giants who serve as his sons.

sections.title: Lord of the Sunken Coast
sections.body: Reclining amidst the brine-crusted ruins of the Temple of Arkkoran, Lord Arkkoroc is far more than a typical sea giant. To hermits like Loramus Thalipedes, this colossal being is considered a lesser deity whose divine will shapes the surrounding waters. His sons patrol the crags and shallows around the sanctuary, enforcing his quiet dominion over Azshara's tempestuous shores.

sections.title: Vengeance Against the Deep
sections.body: Despite his immense divine power, Arkkoroc suffers personal losses beneath the tides. A fearsome, multi-headed hydra named Hetaera has hunted down and butchered many of his sons along the cliffs. Unable or unwilling to directly hunt the beast down, Arkkoroc barters valuable knowledge and occult aid to any wandering adventurer strong enough to present him with the heads of his offspring's killer.

faq.answer: Lord Arkkoroc is a massive sea giant who resides in the Temple of Arkkoran in Azshara. He is revered as a lesser deity of the seas and rules over a brood of sea giants whom he considers his sons.

faq.q: Where can I find Lord Arkkoroc?
faq.answer: You can find him perched amidst the ruins of the Temple of Arkkoran, located on the eastern coastline and rocky reefs of Azshara.

faq.q: Why does Loramus Thalipedes send adventurers to Arkkoroc?
faq.answer: Loramus Thalipedes directs travelers to Arkkoroc to seek arcane insights concerning a powerful demon. As a lesser sea deity, Arkkoroc holds ancient knowledge, but he demands that adventurers slay the hydra Hetaera before he parts with his secrets.

faq.q: Why is Arkkoroc angry with the hydra Hetaera?
faq.answer: The savage sea beast Hetaera slaughtered several of Arkkoroc's sons who were patrolling the coastline. Seeking revenge for his slain kin, the sea giant demands her heads.

angles.text: The ruins of the Temple of Arkkoran stand upon former Highborne lands, where an ancient sea entity now reigns supreme over the fallen majesty of old Kalimdor.
